texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo: Wow!\nIt's huge!\pThe BATTLE TOWER feels special.\nIt's different from the others.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerL: My grand ambition is to conquer both\nthe BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON\lLEAGUE.\pAnd if my dream comes true…\pI… I'm going to ask MIMI next door\nif she will be friends with me!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidT: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!\nI just can't make it to the top!\pSince I'm out of options, maybe I can\nclimb the outside…$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveIn: I thrive in darkness…\nYes… What is worthy of me?\lNone other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…\pWhat say you to wandering in darkness\nand in utter and total desperation?$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutToget: I didn't sleep for a week, but then\nI put together the ultimate team!\pI can't see myself losing, no joke.\nWe're storming the BATTLE ARENA!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveI: ZIGG!\nI believe in you, little buddy!\pI'll make my little ZIGG any favorite\ntasty treats you like if you win!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeat: I may not look that impressive now,\nbut I once beat a GYM LEADER.\pWho knows, maybe I should give it\nanother shot at glory.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScott:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?\pIt sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…\pI've never seen him battling in person
ever.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCa:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.\pYour hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!\lOops, it's almost dinnertime!\pI don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBi: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for\nthe way I battle, too.\pI win matches in the blink of\nan eye!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterTh: I'm better than my daddy\nat POKéMON.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUp: Go on, my baby sweetie!\nGo rack up some wins for Daddy!\pYou're just like your mother,\nso you'll be dominating!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPre:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout\lpretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.\pInstead of her, do you know what
I found?\pA whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Sometime: I sometimes see this really important-\nlooking old man going in there.\pHe has these really awesome POKéMON.\nHe seems really nice, though.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOf:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?\pWhen there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,\lthere shall appear a man among men.\pDon't know that legend?
Well, of course not!\lI just made it up!\pWhat's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWiped:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!\pBut I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!\pAnd then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTra: This guy ran into a horribly tough\nTRAINER while he was on the BATTLE\lTOWER challenge.\pNow look at him…\pYou need to be cautious if you ever\ndecide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBa: Yes!\nI've finally got enough Battle Points!\pI guess I'll trade for another giant\nplush DOLL!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHa: Oh, yeah, okay!\nSo this is the RANKING HALL!\pI'd like to go down in history as\na super champ and have my name\lrecorded here for posterity.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAny: With you by my side, I can do anything.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfO:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!\pOoh, I just can't wait anymore!\pLet's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!\pIf we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome\leveryone we meet.\pWhy, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeH: Excuse me, young one.\nHave you good eyesight?\pThere is an odd tree past here, and to\nmy tired eyes it seems to wiggle.$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Frontier:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.\pMany people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.\pThat man SCOTT…\pHe may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMo:
I…
I saw it!\pThere was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!\pIt was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo: This is the BATTLE TOWER!\nKeep the win streak as the toughest\lTRAINER!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePa: This is the BATTLE PALACE!\nKeep your eyes on POKéMON battles!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleAr: This is the BATTLE ARENA!\nLet the toughest teams gather!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePy: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!\nAdvance through the Battle Quest!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Exchange: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER\nExchange your Battle Points!$

texts.BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingH: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL\nSet your sights on new records!$
